title: Zilean and Deceiver Reflection copies
explanation: Zilean's replacement effect makes a second ready Reflection as Deceiver plays one. After both tokens resolve, Deceiver's reflexive trigger makes both copies of the chosen unit and grants both Temporary. Becoming Zilean copies does not create another play event, so no loop occurs.
